resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com calls the 1934 structure a camp; Forest Lookouts and Idaho Fire Lookouts call it a tent cabin. The story treats these as one 1934 structure described two ways.

notes_for_editor: Three Bowery records exist: us-id-bowery (this one; point from Idaho Fire Lookouts), us-id-bowery-2 (FFLA, 43.98591, -114.53006, Custer County) and us-id-bowery-g-s (Forest Lookouts Bowery G. S., 43.9976, -114.5173). They look like duplicates to merge. Ketchum is listed at 43.68, -114.365 on Wikipedia (not cited in the story). The recorded point sits about 25 miles due north of Ketchum, while the firelookout.com description is 20 miles NNW; the other two records fit that bearing, so the recorded point probably needs replacing. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives elevation as an unknown value and no staffing history; the story leaves staffing out. Elevation 10,332 feet comes from firelookout.com only. No source describes the site today.
